result.title: Learning to Read Braille: Benchmarking and Improving Braille Recognition Capabilities of VLMs
result.comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/kartik0806/BrailleBench
result.summary: Despite rapid progress in visual understanding and document transcription, modern vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with a fundamental accessibility task: reading Braille from images. We introduce BrailleBench, a manually curated benchmark of 259 real-world Grade-1 and Grade-2 Braille images. We evaluate proprietary, open-weight, OCR-specialized, and tool-assisted multimodal systems and find that standalone general-purpose models perform poorly at directly transcribing Braille images, whereas tool-assisted systems perform much better. We design a synthetic Braille generation pipeline with diverse layouts and image perturbations. A 2B VLM model trained on our synthetic data reaches 87% exact match on Grade-1 and 61% on Grade-2 BrailleBench, outperforming standalone VLMs and achieving the highest Grade-2 exact match score among the evaluated systems. We further show that high accuracy on synthetic validation data does not guarantee high accuracy on real photographs in our experiments: models trained on prior synthetic data reach up to 96% on their synthetic validation set but at most 3.26% on Grade-1 BrailleBench. Our results identify an accessibility-relevant capability gap in multimodal systems and show that targeted synthetic supervision can improve real-world Braille transcription.

AI.brief_summary: 该文构建 BrailleBench（259 张真实盲文图像基准），评测通用、开源自权重、OCR 专用及工具辅助 VLM 的盲文转写能力，并用带布局与图像扰动的合成数据微调 2B 模型，指出合成验证集高准确率与真实照片低准确率之间的巨大落差。
AI.relevance_reason: 盲文点阵识别依赖极细粒度空间细节，可能作为检验视觉细节能否保留在内部状态中的极端测试；其「合成集高、真实集低」的落差可供核查视觉监督与分布偏移对表征和证据使用的影响。
